Status_Label: Sun Pharma row replaced with audited consolidated Q4FY26 figures
Tooltip: Sun Pharma Q4FY26 row uses audited consolidated figures from May 22 2026 results. Reports under Ind AS (Indian Accounting Standards, IFRS-aligned).
Data_Treatment_Note: Q_R&D uses Revenue R&D (₹9,500.3M operating R&D expense), not Total R&D Expenditure (₹9,757.3M which includes capex on R&D facilities). Q_SG&A computed as Employee Benefits Expense (₹29,604.1M) + Other Expenses (₹53,228.4M) = ₹82,832.5M, since Sun Pharma does not disclose a single 'Selling, general and administration' line under Ind AS reporting. Q_Cash = Cash and cash equivalents (₹97,705.1M) + Current Investments (₹209,334.5M) = ₹307,039.6M, applying the broader liquidity definition consistent with the dataset's cash + marketable securities convention. Market_Cap derived from audited share count (2,399,300,000 shares from balance sheet equity ₹2,399.3M ÷ ₹1 face value) × March 2026 closing price (approximately ₹1,786 per share). FX rate 91.49 INR/USD per company disclosure.
Source_Files: Sun Pharma Q4 FY26 Audited Consolidated Results (May 22 2026): consolidated income statement p.18, consolidated balance sheet p.19, Sales and R&D snapshot p.25
